name: Chess Wizards Camp at Ramapo
operator_name: Chess Wizards with Town of Ramapo Parks & Recreation
description_short: Week long chess camp for ages 5 to 12 of every skill level, from beginners to advanced players, at the JTS Center in Hillburn, with full day and half day options.
notes: Full day 9 am to 3 pm, $365 a session; half day 9 am to noon or noon to 3 pm, $250 a session. Session prices shown are full day.
